The first question is split into Pourquoi, es-tu and encore là. The es-tu chunk is glossed as 你是 although être is locative here; the correct whole-sentence translation does not repair that contextually incorrect local gloss.

issues.description: In Pourquoi es-tu encore là ?, être expresses being/remain at a place. The isolated es-tu chunk is taught with the copular Chinese meaning 你是, which does not fit this source. Combined with the adjacent 還在這裡 gloss it gives an incorrect contextual construction.
issues.suggestedDirection: Keep es-tu encore là as a meaningful locative chunk with a contextual Chinese meaning, or supply a locative gloss rather than 是.
